verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents its own control mapping to framework requirements for each supported framework (including SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA) and automatic mapping of controls to CMMC requirements to find gaps. The evidence never says that controls or evidence done for one framework automatically count toward another, or that the overlap is displayed. Missing for 10: explicit cross-framework control/evidence reuse (SOC 2 → ISO 27001/HIPAA), an overlap or crosswalk view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, controls and evidence map ACROSS frameworks — work done for SOC 2 counts toward ISO 27001 and HIPAA automatically, with the overlap shown

citations.quote: Each supported framework includes control mapping to framework requirements, automated control testing that collects compliance evidence from integrated technologies
Map controls to CMMC requirements automatically to identify gaps and readiness status
